artifact_observations.reasoning: The white cable connecting to the bottom of the iPod does not plug into a standard jack. Instead, it seems to merge into a bulky, undefined beige plastic housing that floats slightly above the surface, lacking a clear physical connector mechanism.

The texture of the white cables is inconsistent; parts look like smooth plastic tubes while other sections have a strange braided or ribbed texture that doesn't match standard Apple earphone cabling. The coiling also defies some gravity/tension logic.

The gold embossed patterns on the green background resemble musical notation and instruments but degrade into nonsensical shapes and pseudo-text upon close inspection, typical of AI-generated decorative elements.
The screen content (the white blob) does not align perfectly with the perspective of the device frame, appearing slightly flat and disconnected from the glass surface.
